text:
Amira Khan: Quick heads-up — starting next Monday we'll reorganize the Model Onboarding team into a new "Model Lifecycle" org under Runtime. This is to streamline model rollouts, evals, and serving handoffs.
Diego Morales: Happy to step in as interim lead for Model Lifecycle for ~6 weeks while we run a hire. Will keep a part-time slice on my current infra work to avoid gaps.
Priya Natarajan: Congrats Diego, sounds good. Who's covering Diego's day-to-day infra tasks during the interim?
Diego Morales: We've assigned Raya Olson as interim infra point for the critical flows (oncall, capacity planning, deployment approvals). Raya, can you confirm capacity?
Raya Olson: Confirmed — I will own oncall and capacity planning until the new hire is onboarded. I'll post an interim oncall rota and a short handoff doc in #eng-infra by EOD Thu.
Amira Khan: Hiring plan: req is going live today for "Senior Manager, Model Lifecycle" (people manager + product-operational focus). Recruiter: @Lina Chavez leading. Target loop: 3–4 weeks. Banding and JD in the shared drive (link posted in #people-ops).
Lina Chavez: Taking ownership. Please DM any candidate referrals or post them here. I'll also share the job post in #jobs in ~30m.
Priya Natarajan: Any immediate customer or SLA impacts from the reorg?
Amira Khan: No SLA changes. We're keeping existing deploy cadence. If we see any capacity regressions, we'll use Dedicated fallback routing and notify affected customers. Ops playbook will be updated.
Diego Morales: I'll publish a short runbook with the responsibility diffs — what I'm handing to Raya and what stays with Runtime. Also scheduling a 30-min cross-functional sync Tue 10:00 to align product, infra, and CS.
Raya Olson: FYI — I'll update PagerDuty and the escalation matrix tonight. Also adding a checklist for incident triage to the runbook.
Amira Khan: Quick FAQ to reduce questions: 1) Will compensation change for current folks? No immediate changes. 2) Promotions/levels? Handled through regular review cycles. 3) How to raise concerns? Reply here or DM People Ops.
Lina Chavez: Recruiter note: please share hiring bar, must-have vs nice-to-have in a comment — will tailor outreach accordingly.
Diego Morales: Thanks team — excited to get this moving. Appreciate the quick coverage, Raya. :rocket:
Amira Khan: Thanks everyone. I'll post the org chart fragment and the new reporting lines in #people-ops after this thread.
